Name: Luxury Barns n Coops
Author: omena007
Description:
This mod adds two new building: Luxury Coop and Luxury Barn. Both buildings house 16 animals, and have everything the animals need: heating, auto: feed+petter+grabber and manure collecting system that gives you fertiliser every day. The buildings can be commissioned from Robin after you have built a Deluxe version of a barn/coop*. Right now the buildings don't unlock any animals so the base game unlocking logic still applies.

There's config option to have ostriches in the coop instead of the barn and vanilla/desaturated snow on the roof.

I've added spots for animals to sleep in (chicken nooks and stables etc) so if you want to see them use mushymato's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties (MMAP)[/url]**

The ducks will swim in the pools but I recommend to use[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15860] Like a duck to water mod [/url]to see them do it more often. Other animals might go to the pool but don't worry, the water is shallow :')

* The reason why I didn't add these buildings as upgrades to deluxe buildings is because the layout is very different from them and it resulted eggs etc floating around ^^'
